reasoning: On the season so far the Clippers are the stronger team; with home court the Clippers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets (look-ahead, confidence).
Bottom line: the Clippers win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 189 and 237 total points.
